text:
Fixed the parameter processing order in `iter_params_for_processing`.

Root cause: sorting prioritized command-line invocation order before `is_eager`, allowing non-eager options to run first when they appeared earlier.

Change: eager parameters are now always processed before non-eager parameters, while preserving invocation order within each group and declaration order for uninvoked parameters.

All targeted tests pass: **151 passed**.

Fixed the parameter processing order in `iter_params_for_processing`.

Root cause: sorting prioritized command-line invocation order before `is_eager`, allowing non-eager options to run first when they appeared earlier.

Change: eager parameters are now always processed before non-eager parameters, while preserving invocation order within each group and declaration order for uninvoked parameters.

All targeted tests pass: **151 passed**.
